scripts.copy:skill: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");fs.rmSync(".temp/skill",{recursive:true,force:true});fs.mkdirSync(".temp/skill",{recursive:true});for(const i of ["SKILL.md","script","README.md","package.json"])fs.cpSync(i,".temp/skill/"+i,{recursive:true});const f=".temp/skill/package.json";const p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8"));for(const d of Object.keys(p.dependencies))p.dependencies[d]=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("node_modules/"+d+"/package.json","utf8")).version;delete p.scripts;fs.writeFileSync(f,JSON.stringify(p,null,2)+"\n");console.log("[copy:skill] SKILL 核心已复制到 .temp/skill；依赖版本写死、scripts 段已清:",p.dependencies)'
